segments.ne15:2.1: “Uddhaṃ adho sabbadhi vippamutto, ayaṃ ahasmīti [ayamahamasmīti (sī.) passa udā.61] anānupassī;
segments.ne15:2.3: Evaṃ vimutto udatāri oghaṃ, atiṇṇapubbaṃ apunabbhavāyā”ti.
segments.ne15:3.4: Tāniyeva asekkhāni pañcindriyāni, ayaṃ indriyehi otaraṇā.
segments.ne15:4.1: Tāniyeva asekkhāni pañcindriyāni vijjā, vijjuppādā avijjānirodho, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
segments.ne15:5.1: Tāniyeva asekkhāni pañcindriyāni tīhi khandhehi saṅgahitāni – sīlakkhandhena samādhikkhandhena paññākkhandhena, ayaṃ khandhehi otaraṇā.
segments.ne15:6.1: Tāniyeva asekkhāni pañcindriyāni saṅkhārapariyāpannāni ye saṅkhārā anāsavā, no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā.
segments.ne15:7.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ, no ca bhavaṅgaṃ.
segments.ne15:8.1: “Ayaṃ ahasmīti anānupassī”ti ayaṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā samugghāto, sā sekkhāvimutti, tāniyeva sekkhāni pañcindriyāni.
segments.ne15:9.1: Tāniyeva sekkhāni pañcindriyāni vijjā, vijjuppādā avijjānirodho, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, evaṃ sabbo paṭiccasamuppādo.
segments.ne15:11.1: Sāyeva vijjā saṅkhārapariyāpannā, ye saṅkhārā anāsavā, no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā, ayaṃ dhātūhi otaraṇā.
segments.ne15:12.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ, no ca bhavaṅgaṃ, ayaṃ āyatanehi otaraṇā.
segments.ne15:13.1: Sekkhāya ca vimuttiyā asekkhāya ca vimuttiyā vimutto udatāri oghaṃ atiṇṇapubbaṃ apunabbhavāya.
segments.ne15:14.1: “Nissitassa [passa udā.74] calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ natthi, calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti, natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti, āgatigatiyā asati cutūpapāto na hoti, cutūpapāte asati nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena esevanto dukkhassā”ti.
segments.ne15:15.1: “Nissitassa calitan”ti nissayo nāma duvidho taṇhānissayo ca diṭṭhinissayo ca.
segments.ne15:15.2: Tattha yā rattassa cetanā, ayaṃ taṇhānissayo;
segments.ne15:15.4: Cetanā pana saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, evaṃ sabbo paṭiccasamuppādo.
segments.ne15:16.1: Tattha yā rattassa vedanā, ayaṃ sukhā vedanā.
segments.ne15:16.2: Yā sammūḷhassa vedanā, ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanā, imā dve vedanā vedanākkhandho.
segments.ne15:17.1: Tattha sukhā vedanā dve indriyāni sukhindriyaṃ somanassindriyañca, adukkhamasukhā vedanā upekkhindriyaṃ.
segments.ne15:18.1: Tāniyeva indriyāni saṅkhārapariyāpannāni, ye saṅkhārā sāsavā bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā.
segments.ne15:19.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ sāsavaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ, ayaṃ āyatanehi otaraṇā.
segments.ne15:20.1: “Anissitassa calitaṃ natthī”ti samathavasena vā taṇhāya anissito vipassanāvase vā diṭṭhiyā anissito.
segments.ne15:20.2: Yā vipassanā ayaṃ vijjā, vijjuppādā avijjānirodho, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, evaṃ sabbo paṭiccasamuppādo.
segments.ne15:22.1: Sāyeva vipassanā dve indriyāni – vīriyindriyañca paññindriyañca.
segments.ne15:23.1: Sāyeva vipassanā saṅkhārapariyāpannā, ye saṅkhārā anāsavā, no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā.
segments.ne15:24.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ, no ca bhavaṅgaṃ.
segments.ne15:25.1: “Passaddhiyā satī”ti duvidhā passaddhi kāyikā ca cetasikā ca.
segments.ne15:25.3: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ, ayaṃ cetasikā passaddhi.
segments.ne15:25.4: Passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati [vedayati (ka.)], sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, samāhito yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yathābhūtaṃ pajānanto nibbindati, nibbindanto virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ “vimutta” miti [vimuttamhīti (sī. ka.)] ñāṇaṃ hoti,“khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānāti.
segments.ne15:25.5: So na namati rūpesu, na saddesu, na gandhesu, na rasesu, na phoṭṭhabbesu, na dhammesu khayā rāgassa khayā dosassa khayā mohassa yena rūpena tathāgataṃ tiṭṭhantaṃ carantaṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, tassa rūpassa khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā rūpasaṅkhaye vimutto, tathāgato atthītipi na upeti, natthītipi na upeti, atthi natthītipi na upeti, nevatthi no natthītipi na upeti.
segments.ne15:25.6: Atha kho gambhīro appameyyo asaṅkheyyo nibbutotiyeva saṅkhaṃ gacchati khayā rāgassa, khayā dosassa, khayā mohassa.
segments.ne15:26.4: Yena viññāṇena tathāgataṃ tiṭṭhantaṃ carantaṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, tassa viññāṇassa khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā viññāṇasaṅkhaye vimutto, tathāgato atthītipi na upeti, natthītipi na upeti, atthi natthītipi na upeti, nevatthi no natthītipi na upeti.
segments.ne15:26.5: Atha kho gambhīro appameyyo asaṅkheyyo nibbutotiyeva saṅkhaṃ gacchati khayā rāgassa, khayā dosassa, khayā mohassa. “Āgatī”ti idhāgati.
segments.ne15:26.8: Āgatigatīpi na bhavanti,“nevidhā”ti chasu ajjhattikesu āyatanesu.
segments.ne15:26.10: “Na ubhayamantarenā”ti phassasamuditesu dhammesu attānaṃ na passati.
segments.ne15:26.12: So duvidho lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca.
segments.ne15:26.13: Tattha lokiyo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, yāva jarāmaraṇā.
segments.ne15:26.14: Lokuttaro sīlavato avippaṭisāro jāyati, yāva nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
segments.ne15:26.15: Tenāha bhagavā “nissitassa calitaṃ anissitassa calitaṃ natthi … pe … esevanto dukkhassā”ti.
segments.ne15:27.1: “Ye keci sokā paridevitā vā, dukkhā [dukkhaṃ (sī. ka.) passa udā.78] ca lokasmimanekarūpā;
segments.ne15:27.3: Piyaṃ paṭiccappabhavanti ete, piye asante na bhavanti ete.
segments.ne15:28.1: Tasmā hi te sukhino vītasokā, yesaṃ piyaṃ natthi kuhiñci loke;
segments.ne15:28.3: Tasmā asokaṃ virajaṃ patthayāno, piyaṃ na kayirātha kuhiñci loke”ti.
segments.ne15:29.1: “Ye keci sokā paridevitā vā, dukkhā ca lokasmimanekarūpā piyaṃ paṭiccappabhavanti ete”ti – ayaṃ dukkhā vedanā.
segments.ne15:29.3: “Piye asante na bhavanti ete”ti – ayaṃ sukhā vedanā.
segments.ne15:30.1: Vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ, evaṃ sabbaṃ.
segments.ne15:31.1: Tattha sukhā vedanā dve indriyāni – sukhindriyaṃ somanassindriyañca.
segments.ne15:31.3: Dukkhā vedanā dve indriyāni – dukkhindriyaṃ domanassindriyañca.
segments.ne15:32.1: Tāniyeva indriyāni saṅkhārapariyāpannāni, ye saṅkhārā sāsavā bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā.
segments.ne15:33.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ sāsavaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ.
segments.ne15:34.1: Tasmā hi te sukhino vītasokā, yesaṃ piyaṃ natthi kuhiñci loke;
segments.ne15:34.3: Tasmā asokaṃ virajaṃ patthayāno, piyaṃ na kayirātha kuhiñci loketi.
segments.ne15:35.2: Taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, evaṃ sabbaṃ.
segments.ne15:36.2: So samatho dve indriyāni satindriyaṃ samādhindriyañca.
segments.ne15:38.1: Soyeva samatho saṅkhārapariyāpanno, ye saṅkhārā anāsavā, no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā.
segments.ne15:39.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ, no ca bhavaṅgaṃ.
segments.ne15:40.1: Kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati;
segments.ne15:40.3: Addhā pītimano hoti, laddhā macco yadicchati.
segments.ne15:42.1: Yo kāme parivajjeti, sappasseva [sabbasseva (ka.) passa su. ni.774] padā siro;
segments.ne15:43.3: Anunayaṃ paṭighañca pana taṇhāpakkho, taṇhāya ca pana dasarūpīni āyatanāni padaṭṭhānaṃ.
segments.ne15:44.1: Tāniyeva dasa rūpīni rūpakāyo nāmasampayutto, tadubhayaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, evaṃ sabbaṃ.
segments.ne15:47.1: Tattha yo rūpakāyo imāni pañca rūpīni indriyāni, yo nāmakāyo imāni pañca arūpīni indriyāni, imāni dasa indriyāni.
segments.ne15:50.1: Ayaṃ saupādisesā nibbānadhātu, ayaṃ dhātūhi otaraṇā.
segments.ne15:51.1: Sāyeva saupādisesā nibbānadhātu vijjā, vijjuppādā avijjānirodho, avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, evaṃ sabbaṃ.
segments.ne15:53.1: Sāyeva vijjā dve indriyāni – vīriyindriyaṃ paññindriyañca.
segments.ne15:54.1: Sāyeva vijjā saṅkhārapariyāpannā, ye saṅkhārā anāsavā, no ca bhavaṅgā, te saṅkhārā dhammadhātusaṅgahitā.
segments.ne15:55.1: Sā dhammadhātu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, yaṃ āyatanaṃ anāsavaṃ, no ca bhavaṅgaṃ.

lines: Tattha asekkhā vimuttīti ayaṃ tedhātuke vītarāgatā asekkhā phalavimutti.
Ayaṃ indriyehi otaraṇāti asekkhāya vimuttiyā niddhāritehi saddhādīhi indriyehi saṃvaṇṇanāya otaraṇā.
Pañcindriyāni vijjāti sammāsaṅkappo viya sammādiṭṭhiyā upakārakattā paññākkhandhe saddhādīni cattāri indriyāni vijjāya upakārakattā saṅgaṇhanavasena vuttāni.
Ye saṅkhārā anāsavāti taṃ saṅkhārakkhandhaṃ viseseti, aggaphalassa adhippetattā.

Yadipi pubbe vītarāgatā asekkhā vimutti dassitā, tassā pana paṭipattidassanatthaṃ “ayaṃ ahamasmīti anānupassī”ti dassanamaggo idha vuttoti imamatthaṃ dassetuṃ “ayaṃ ahamasmīti anānupassī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
So hi taṇhācaritassa patiṭṭhābhāvena tathā vutto.
Rattassa cetanāti cetanāpadhānattā saṅkhārakkhandhadhammānaṃ cetanāsīsena taṇhaṃ eva vadati.
Yasmā pana viparītābhiniveso mohassa balavabhāve eva hoti, tasmā “yā mūḷhassa cetanā, ayaṃ diṭṭhinissayo”ti vuttaṃ.

words: yā rattassa vedanā  ayaṃ sukhā vedanā
yā sammūḷhassa vedanā  ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanā
lines: Evaṃ cetanāsīsena taṇhādiṭṭhiyo vatvā idāni tattha nippariyāyena cetanaṃyeva gaṇhanto “cetanā pana saṅkhārā”ti āha.
Yā rattassa vedanā, ayaṃ sukhā vedanāti sukhāya vedanāya rāgo anusetīti katvā vuttaṃ.
Tathā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjā anusetīti āha –
Yathā vā sesadhammānaṃ taṇhāya nissayabhāve puggalo taṇhāya nissitoti vuccati.
Evaṃ taṇhāya sesadhammānaṃ paccayabhāve puggalo taṇhāya nissitoti vuccatīti āha –

Yasmā pana sā darathapaṭippassaddhi kāyacittānaṃ sukhe sati pākaṭā hoti, tasmā “yaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhan”tiādinā phalūpacārena vuttāya passaddhiyā natiabhāvassa kāraṇabhāvaṃ dassetuṃ “passaddhakāyo”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Atthītipi na upetīti sassato attā ca loko cātipi taṇhādiṭṭhiupayena na upeti na gaṇhāti.
Idha huranti dvārārammaṇadhammā dassitāti “ubhayamantarenā”ti padena dvārappavattadhamme dassento “phassasamuditesu dhammesū”ti āha.
Tassattho – phassena saddhiṃ phassena kāraṇabhūtena ca samuditesu sambhūtesu viññāṇavedanāsaññācetanāvitakkavicārādidhammesu.
Attānaṃ na passatīti tesaṃ dhammānaṃ anattabhāveneva tattha attānaṃ na passati.
Virajjati virāgā vimuccatīti padehi lokuttaradhammānaṃ paṭiccasamuppādabhāvaṃ dassento tadatthatāya sīlādīnampi pariyāyena tabbhāvamāha “lokuttaro”tiādinā.
